rules.statement: The Land Commissioner is entitled to appeal to the Privy Council as of right if the matter in dispute on the appeal amounts to or is of the value of five thousand rupees or upwards, or where the appeal involves directly, or indirectly some claim or question to or respecting property or some civil right amounting or of the value of five thousand rupees or upwards.
rules.supporting_quote: "1.
